doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

lmb.source: Data: Lunar Dash is a plain short dash. Footage: the ground dash is never shown cleanly. Ours: the ember goes the step the 0.2s skip ends (held to the dash end, the default: nothing in the source shows otherwise).

rmb.source: Data: Darkside Binding has no dash rule. Footage: not cast from a dash. Ours: the seed is thrown from the skip (its own small hop and push).

e.source: Data: Moonlight Blessing is a zone on herself that follows her. Footage: not cast from a dash. Ours: the light goes up on her mid-skip and moves with her.

x.source: Data: the channel is cancelled only by stun, knock or range, not by moving. Footage (ult f41-f72): she walks while it runs. Ours: the tether starts mid-skip.

lmb.source: Data: Lunar Air Dash, further in the air. Footage (730.7-732.4 s): a streak then a seated float with the arms out; no shot during it, she walks out with the arms raised. Ours: the ember goes as the float ends.

rmb.source: Data: no dash rule. Footage: not shown from the air dash. Ours: the seed leaves from the float.

e.source: Data: the zone sits on her. Footage: not shown from the air dash. Ours: the light goes up on her mid-float.

x.source: Data: moving doesn't cancel the channel. Ours: the tether starts mid-float.

rmb.reason: Burrseed's fixed 1 s wind-up outlasts the hop, so the seed leaves after she lands
rmb.source: Ours: owner items 118 and 118b, the wind-up and snap release.

lmb.source: Footage (716.3-717.6 s): she pushes embers while moving. Ours: Shift skips at once between embers.

rmb.source: Ours: Shift while aiming the seed skips; the throw still goes on release.

e.source: Data: the zone follows her (recast throws it). Ours: Shift goes at once, the light moves with her.

x.source: Data: cancelled only by stun, knock or moving too far. Footage: she walks through the channel. Ours: Shift goes at once and the tether holds while she stays in the ring.

window.source: Pip (mooshmoosh.md 321, 340; 30 fps crops): every dash comes 0.1-0.3 s after a jump and the air dash lasts 0.6 s; no ability pressed inside a dash is shown.

glide_rows.source: Owner rule, briefs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08: Shift cancels into glide instantly for every Hunter; glide opens only on a press, never a hold. Source rows for this dash: the air dash rows above.
glide_rows.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. Her air Shift is the 0.9 s Elluna glide-dash: the press ends it. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: no source row for a glide pressed after this Hunter's abilities (data and footage silent). Kept: owner item 162b, no glider inside an ability's animation (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md).
glide_rows.ours: glide opens when the move's keys end, pressed after a tap: LMB 0.43 s; RMB n/a; E 0.63 s; X 0.32 s; Q at once (n/a: the press did not go off in the air in the check).

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: same as above. Kept: owner item 162b, a hold keeps the glider shut (Kael 113.2, Grimble bug 26 pattern stays).
glide_rows.ours: glide pressed 0.3 s into a hold: LMB shut while held; RMB n/a; E 0.53 s; X 0.05 s; Q at once.
